name: A quiet patch in Aquarius
blurb: A neighboring patch observed during the same two days, where the pipeline found nothing moving. Use it to see how stars change brightness from frame to frame only because each image is taken at a different infrared wavelength.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2025-06-03, at wavelengths from 1.67 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found no moving objects bright enough to track.
